create_augmenter_instance: create an Augmenter instance with mask config, augmentation types, and their parameters
parse_augmentations_config: parse augmentation names and parameters into a normalized probability-weighted list of transforms
apply_post_augmentation: apply a randomly selected geometric or value metric augmentation to a watermarked image and mask
run_augmenter_forward: run the Augmenter forward pass to generate augmented watermarked images with mask targets
test_augmenter_cli: test the Augmenter module by running python -m watermark_anything.augmentation.augmenter to generate sample outputs
